notes: Review of the 1.1.7 integration (M3): the genuine Discord started through its Squirrel stub (Update.exe --processStart Discord.exe --process-start-args) and its network-service child (same image, --type=utility --user-data-dir=...) read their own stores and talk to discord.com; then the app updates itself: the old version starts the new one, which restarts through Electron's relauncher (--type=relauncher --- "<same Discord.exe>"), as on the owner's PC (replay 2026-10). The Electron-owner guard (plain launch, trusted launcher or a plain instance of itself) must keep them owners.
